item.title: Nikmedes #6683 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to Be
item.description: Nikmedes #6683 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to Bear Mountain. Only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Pythides #3973 the Twice-Born
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Pythides #3973 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to the Field of Ares. Pythides has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.
